deck_title: Huygens Horologium Oscillatorium L_free = 4R*cos(psi/2) cycloid evolute tautochrone pendulum vs naive circular pendulum rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Christiaan Huygens (1659/1673, Horologium Oscillatorium) cycloid evolute-involute tautochrone pendulum law (wrapping the suspension cord onto cycloidal cheek jaws so the unwrapped radius of curvature shortens as L_free = 4*R*cos(psi/2) = L_0 / (1 + u) and arc-length acceleration obeys d^2s/dt^2 + (g/4R)*s = 0, locking L_active / L_Huygens = 1.0000x across all 17 swing-angle stations u = sec(psi/2) - 1 in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive fixed-pin circular pendulum (keeping L = L_0 = 4R, which overshoots the tautochrone radius of curvature by sec(psi/2) = 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stations) and 64-segment evolute arc-wrapping quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: 3D astronomical clock escapements, kinetic-art wave-pendulum sculptures, large-amplitude swinging censers, and skatepark/rollercoaster cycloid bowl animations
Enforcing exact linear arc-length harmonic motion s(t) = s_0 * cos(sqrt(g / 4R) * t) with amplitude-invariant period T = 2*pi*sqrt(4R / g)
Modeling cycloidal evolute cheeks that shorten the free suspension cord as L_free = 4R * cos(psi/2)
not_for: Rigid rods that cannot wrap onto cycloidal evolute cheeks
Overdamped viscous dashpots with zero oscillation
